import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        List<Long>[] ve = new ArrayList[11];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
            ve[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        long[] sum = new long[11];

        final long mod1 = 998244353;
        final long mod2 = 1000000007;

        long cnt = 0;
        long tmp = 0;
        long ans = 0;

        Function<Long, Long> m1 = (Long x) -> ((x % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;

        // dfs1 function
        BiConsumer<Integer, Long> dfs1 = new BiConsumer<Integer, Long>() {
            @Override
            public void accept(Integer x, Long v) {
                if (v > n) return;
                if (x > 6) return;
                cnt++;
                long val = m1.apply(cnt - v);
                ve[x].add(val);
                sum[x] += val;
                for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                    accept(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
                }
            }
        };

        // dfs2 function
        BiConsumer<Integer, Long> dfs2 = new BiConsumer<Integer, Long>() {
            @Override
            public void accept(Integer x, Long v) {
                if (v > n) return;
                if (x >= 1) {
                    if (v * 10 * n > n && v * n + n - 1 <= n) {
                        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                            long val = m1.apply(cnt - v);
                            List<Long> vec = ve[i];
                            int pos = lowerBound(vec, mod1 - val);
                            long sumVec = sum[i];
                            long size = vec.size();
                            long contribution = (val * size + sumVec - mod1 * (size - pos)) % mod2;
                            if (contribution < 0) contribution += mod2;
                            ans = (ans + contribution) % mod2;
                        }
                        cnt += tmp;
                        return;
                    }
                    cnt++;
                    long val = m1.apply(cnt - v);
                    ans = (ans + val) % mod2;
                }
                int start = (x == 0) ? 1 : 0;
                for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {
                    accept(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
                }
            }
        };

        // Run dfs1
        ((BiConsumer<Integer, Long>) dfs1).accept(0, 0L);
        tmp = cnt;
        cnt = 0;

        // sort ve[i]
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(ve[i]);
        }

        // Run dfs2
        ((BiConsumer<Integer, Long>) dfs2).accept(0, 0L);

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    // Helper method for lower_bound
    public static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
